About **1,470 people** booked into King County jail between Oct 1, 2025 and Sep 30, 2026 were still in custody on Oct 2, 2026. That's out of about 14,200 people booked in that period, or roughly 10%. Most are held in the county's two jails, and about 400 are on electronic home detention.

| Current facility | Bookings | People (approx.) |
|---|---:|---:|
| King County Correctional Facility (downtown Seattle) | 1,083 | 619 |
| Maleng Regional Justice Center (Kent) | 644 | 448 |
| Electronic Home Detention | 618 | 401 |
| Community Correction Division | 3 | 1 |
| **Total** | **2,348** | **~1,468** |

Of the 1,468, about 1,067 are physically in one of the two jails.

**How I counted:**
- **The data stops on Oct 2.** I used King County's "Adult Jail Booking" dataset (`j56h-zgnm`), which was last updated on Oct 2, 2026. "Still in custody" means as of that day, not today (Oct 20). Its bookings cover Oct 1, 2025 to Sep 30, 2026, so "the past year" here starts about three weeks earlier than a year back from today.
- **Rows are charges, not people.** The file has about 39,900 rows but only 17,897 bookings, because one booking can have several charges. I counted each booking once using its booking number. The dataset's documentation doesn't confirm what a row is; I worked that out from the data.
- **The people counts are estimates.** The dataset has no person ID, so I counted distinct first, middle and last name combinations. Two different people with the same name would be counted as one, and spelling differences would split one person into two. One person appears under two facilities, which is why the rows add up to 1,469 but the total is 1,468.
- **What counts as "in custody":** a booking that still has a current facility listed. Every booking falls in exactly one facility or none. Some of these bookings have a release date on some of their charges but not others, so I counted the facility field rather than the release date. One booking with no facility listed still has a charge with no release date; I left it out.
- **Unchecked assumptions:** the dataset doesn't say which time zone its timestamps use. I also assumed that a filled-in "current facility" means the person is currently held, and the documentation doesn't confirm that either.

These gaps (what a row is, the time zone, what "current facility" means) could be logged as a knowledge-gap issue for this dataset in opendata-atlas. Want me to write one up?
